WITH item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
)
SELECT dt.d_year,
       i.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
       i.i_brand AS brand,
       SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM date_dim_filtered AS dt
JOIN (
    SELECT ss_item_sk,
           ss_sold_date_sk,
           SUM(ss_sales_price) AS ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM item_filtered)
      AND ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim_filtered)
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
) AS ss
  ON dt.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item_filtered AS i
  ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY dt.d_year, i.i_brand, i.i_brand_id
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
